sentences.text: Pursuant to the directions passed by this Court on 04.01.2024, it has been duly submitted by Mr. S. Chouhan that the deficit court fee has been duly paid.

2. Mr. B. Goswami, the learned Additional Advocate General has placed before this Court an instruction dated 13.02.2024 issued by the Additional District Commissioner, Hojai and from the same it reveals that an estimate has been prepared for the purpose of acquisition of the said land to the tune of Rs.14,29,62,343.97 of which Rs.12,42,54,542.76 have been determined as the compensation to be payable.
3. This Court has duly perused the estimate and from the said it reveals that the estimate has been prepared on the basis of the Land Acquisition Act, 1894.

A question therefore arises as to whether the compensation has Page No.# 4/4 to be paid in terms with the Land Acquisition Act, 1894 or in terms with the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 taking into account that there is a specific notification of the Government of Assam wherein it has been duly mentioned that in respect of acquisition of land under the Assam Land Requisition and Acquisition Act, 1964, the compensation would not be paid in terms with the Act of 2013.
4.
